_note: resume-author's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. Positives are real requests to author / revise / tailor / critique a RESUME or CV for AI-driven hiring pipelines (parser → ranker → human): ATS-friendly formatting, JD vocabulary anchoring, parse verification, JSON Resume source. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY: the four report-* reporting siblings (intel brief / progress / state / strategic — none of which is a resume) plus near-miss career artifacts this skill explicitly does NOT handle (cover letter, LinkedIn profile copy, federal USAJOBS resume, academic CV). The reporting family shares 'report'/'brief' vocabulary; this corpus pins resume-author away from it. routing-eval is lexical-overlap only.
